prometheus_stopped.body:
# HELP foundry_up 1 while the game runs and answers
# TYPE foundry_up gauge
horizon_up 0
# HELP foundry_supervisor_uptime_seconds Seconds since foundry-server started
# TYPE foundry_supervisor_uptime_seconds gauge
horizon_supervisor_uptime_seconds <dynamic>
# HELP foundry_crashes Game crashes since foundry-server started
# TYPE foundry_crashes gauge
horizon_crashes 2
# HELP foundry_tps Ticks per second over the last 5 seconds
# TYPE foundry_tps gauge
horizon_tps 19.9
# HELP foundry_tps_target The tick rate the game aims for (/tick rate)
# TYPE foundry_tps_target gauge
horizon_tps_target 20
# HELP foundry_mspt Milliseconds per tick: the average and the percentiles /tick query reports
# TYPE foundry_mspt gauge
horizon_mspt{stat="average"} 8.25
horizon_mspt{stat="p50"} 7
horizon_mspt{stat="p95"} 12.5
horizon_mspt{stat="p99"} 18
# HELP foundry_players_online Players online
# TYPE foundry_players_online gauge
horizon_players_online 2
# HELP foundry_players_max max-players
# TYPE foundry_players_max gauge
horizon_players_max 20
# HELP foundry_chunks_loaded Chunks loaded
# TYPE foundry_chunks_loaded gauge
horizon_chunks_loaded 321
# HELP foundry_memory_rss_bytes The game process's resident memory
# TYPE foundry_memory_rss_bytes gauge
horizon_memory_rss_bytes 536870912
# HELP foundry_cpu_percent The game process's CPU use (100 = one core)
# TYPE foundry_cpu_percent gauge
horizon_cpu_percent 12.5
